- Delegations must schedule their own briefings/meetings with the Permanent Mission to the UN of the country they are representing (Mission Briefings page, NMUN•NY).
- Timing: Briefings should be scheduled in the New York City area on the day set aside:
  • NY-A delegations: Monday before the conference
  • NY-B delegations: Tuesday before 1 p.m.
- Alternatives if the Mission cannot meet on the set-aside day:
  • Ask if the Mission is willing to meet with the delegation virtually on a date prior to the conference.
- If the Mission lacks space to accommodate the delegation, a limited number of hotel meeting rooms are available for briefings. Request a room via info@nmun.org on a first-come, first-served basis.
- Briefing protocol / scheduling tips:
  • Limit the meeting to one hour and honor the time limit.
  • Send initial request letter/email/phone call (may need several inquiries).
  • Follow up with confirmation letter/email/phone call.
  • Arrive on time; send thank-you note after.
- Tools provided to assist scheduling: Initial Request Letter, Confirmation Letter, and UN Blue Book (for Mission contact data).
